What if you woke up tomorrow... the size of an ant?
Your bed would tower above you like a skyscraper.
A single stair would feel like a cliff.
And a tiny drop of water could hit like a wrecking ball.
But here's where it gets weird.
If you were that small, falling might actually be less deadly, because air resistance would slow you down.
Here's the twist: surviving the fall wouldn't be your biggest problem.
You'd lose body heat much faster.
Your voice would be too weak to carry far.
Dust, puddles, and even ordinary insects could become deadly.
In real science, humans can't simply shrink like this. Our biology and cells don't work that way.
Could you survive a world where a puddle feels like an ocean?
